mechanics.claim: The initial cast deals normal spell damage and applies a leash/mark; the target's missing health slows them, capped at 75%.
mechanics.quote: dealing {{as|physical damage}} and leashing the target for 4 seconds, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} and {{tip|slow|slowed}} by {{as|{{pp|type=target's '''missing''' health|key=%|0 to 75 for 11|key1=%|0 to 75|formula=1% per 1% missing health. ''This is capped at 75%''}}|health}}

mechanics.claim: The recast (Mercy) deals no separate damage number; it is a guaranteed execute that kills the target outright once the channel completes, ignoring current health and heals.
The recast damage/effect is raw damage, unlike the initial cast which is spell damage.
mechanics.quote: Applies {{tip|spell damage}} on first cast and {{tip|raw damage}} on recast.

mechanics.claim: The target will die regardless of current health once the recast's chains hit, even if healed, unless they have persistent invulnerability.
mechanics.quote: The target will die regardless of their {{as|'''current''' health}} once the recast's chains hit, even if they are {{tip|heal|healed}}.

mechanics.claim: During the recast channel the target cannot take damage from any other source than the execution itself.
mechanics.quote: preventing them from taking damage from {{tt|other sources|Negates application of damage from any source that is not the execution}}

mechanics.claim: The initial cast automatically triggers the recast if the hit would kill the target outright (without actually reducing their health below 1).
mechanics.quote: does so automatically if the chem-drill {{tt|would kill the target|Damage instance does not reduce their health below 1 in this case}}

mechanics.claim: Cooldown starts on cast if the initial missile misses; if it hits, cooldown starts after the leash/effect resolves.
mechanics.quote: Starts on-cast if it doesn't hit a target, post-effect if it does

mechanics.claim: Undying Rage prevents death from the execute but the execute still bypasses its minimum health threshold, reducing the target to 1 health instead.
mechanics.quote: {{ai|Undying Rage|Tryndamere}} will prevent {{ci|Tryndamere}} from dying by the execute. In this case, the execute will bypass his minimum health threshold though and reduce him to {{as|1 health}}.

mechanics.claim: Only the target's current health at time of execution counts as Urgot's damage in post-game stats and spell vamp healing.
mechanics.quote: Only the target's {{as|'''current''' health}} will count as '''Urgot's''' damage in post-game statistics and {{tip|spell vamp}} healing.
